_description: Literature-curated gene fusion calls for cell lines the DepMap fusion caller could not call, and recorded alternative fusions for lines it called negative. A fusion call needs RNA-seq; lines without it are not fusion-negative, they are unknown. This file supplies the published answer where one exists, so those lines can join an analysis instead of being held out.
_howToRead: byCellLine[<DepMap ID>].fusions lists fusions the line is documented to carry. An empty list with unknown:true means no fusion is documented and the line stays uncallable. Entries never override a positive call from the caller; they fill in lines the caller had nothing to say about, and record what a caller-negative line carries instead.

ACH-002160.name: MC-IXC
ACH-002160.detail: Type 1 fusion, inherited from the parent line SK-N-MC. Long mislabelled a neuroblastoma line; the parent was shown to come from an Askin tumor.

ACH-002114.name: EW-16
ACH-002114.detail: EWSR1 exon 8 fused to FLI1 exon 7

ACH-002106.name: ES5
ACH-002106.detail: No gene fusion is recorded in Cellosaurus for this line, so its fusion partner remains unknown rather than negative.

ACH-001431.name: TC-205
ACH-001431.detail: EWSR1 exon 7 fused to FEV exon 3. A variant Ewing fusion, so genuinely EWSR1-FLI1 negative.

ACH-000210.name: CADO-ES1
ACH-000210.detail: Cellosaurus notes this line was incorrectly reported to carry EWSR1-FLI1 in one publication; the fusion is EWSR1-ERG.

ACH-001283.name: TC-106
ACH-001283.detail: EWSR1 exon 7 fused to ERG exon 6.
